terminology.rule: WS organizes work; it is not a sequential phase and may span multiple M and P codes.

workstreams.name: Core Contracts & Code Generation
workstreams.scope: Core artifacts, generated types/enums, contract loading and semantic governance.

workstreams.name: Data / Registry / Canonical
workstreams.scope: Source registry, ingest, provenance, time, entity, canonical facts and context.

workstreams.name: Episode / Stage / World / Event
workstreams.scope: Episode detection, Stage projection, C/W/P/A/J/M reconstruction, events and relations.

workstreams.name: Metric Engine
workstreams.scope: P1 metric operators, 116 metrics, input authority, evidence and metric publication.

workstreams.name: Observation / Release / Replay
workstreams.scope: Published observations, immutable release, historical replay and provenance.

workstreams.name: Longitudinal Analytics
workstreams.scope: P1 observed trend and later capability/person/team longitudinal products.

workstreams.name: Training Assessment
workstreams.scope: P4/P5 qualification, competency, evidence, instructor review and team/mission assessment.

workstreams.name: Attribution / Capability Intelligence
workstreams.scope: P2 attribution/normalization and P3 capability/twin/model profile.

workstreams.name: Persistence & Migration
workstreams.scope: DB schema, migrations, repositories, object/Parquet storage and recovery.

workstreams.name: Application / API / DTO
workstreams.scope: Use cases, REST, DTOs, idempotency and service integration.

workstreams.name: GUI / Visualization / Debrief
workstreams.scope: PySide6, timeline, replay, evidence, assessment and analytics UI.

workstreams.name: Verification / Golden / Replay
workstreams.scope: Unit, contract, Golden, replay, migration, E2E and acceptance evidence.

workstreams.name: Cross-Platform Runtime
workstreams.scope: Windows/Linux adapters, packaging, logical equivalence and runtime certification.

workstreams.name: Security & Data Governance
workstreams.scope: Identity, RBAC, audit, privacy, data handling and export governance.

workstreams.name: Performance & Scalability
workstreams.scope: Workload envelope, profiling, concurrency, resource safety and qualification.

workstreams.name: CI/CD / Build / Release
workstreams.scope: Dependency lock, SBOM, package manifest, release, upgrade/rollback and cold-start.

workstreams.name: External / LVC Interoperability
workstreams.scope: External gateways, protocol adapters, time/frame conversion and LVC integration.

workstreams.name: Architecture / Change Governance
workstreams.scope: Baseline lock, traceability, plugin/model/profile publication and change closure.
